001package org.clafer.ast;

003/**
004 * An expression whose value is a set, an integer, a decimal or a string.
005 *
006 * @author jimmy
007 */
008public sealed interface AstSetExpr extends AstExpr permits
009        AstArithm, AstCard, AstChildRelation, AstConcat, AstConstant,
010        AstDecimalConstant, AstDifference, AstDomainRestriction, AstDowncast,
011        AstGlobal, AstIntersection, AstInverse, AstJoin, AstJoinParent,
012        AstJoinRef, AstLength, AstLocal, AstMax, AstMin, AstMinus, AstMod,
013        AstParentRelation, AstProduct, AstRangeRestriction, AstRefRelation,
014        AstStringConstant, AstSum, AstTernary, AstThis, AstTransitiveClosure,
015        AstUnion, AstUpcast {
016}
